1	// Parse backticks
2	
3	import type StateInline from './state_inline.ts'
4	
5	export default function backtick (state: StateInline, silent: boolean): boolean {
6	  let pos = state.pos
7	  const ch = state.src.charCodeAt(pos)
8	
9	  if (ch !== 0x60/* ` */) { return false }
10	
11	  const start = pos
12	  pos++
13	  const max = state.posMax
14	
15	  // scan marker length
16	  while (pos < max && state.src.charCodeAt(pos) === 0x60/* ` */) { pos++ }
17	
18	  const marker = state.src.slice(start, pos)
19	  const openerLength = marker.length
20	
21	  if (state.backticksScanned && (state.backticks[openerLength] || 0) <= start) {
22	    if (!silent) state.pending += marker
23	    state.pos += openerLength
24	    return true
25	  }
26	
27	  let matchEnd = pos
28	  let matchStart
29	
30	  // Nothing found in the cache, scan until the end of the line (or until marker is found)
31	  while ((matchStart = state.src.indexOf('`', matchEnd)) !== -1) {
32	    matchEnd = matchStart + 1
33	
34	    // scan marker length
35	    while (matchEnd < max && state.src.charCodeAt(matchEnd) === 0x60/* ` */) { matchEnd++ }
36	
37	    const closerLength = matchEnd - matchStart
38	
39	    if (closerLength === openerLength) {
40	      // Found matching closer length.
41	      if (!silent) {
42	        const token = state.push('code_inline', 'code', 0)
43	        token.markup = marker
44	        token.content = state.src.slice(pos, matchStart)
45	          .replace(/\n/g, ' ')
46	          .replace(/^ (.+) $/, '$1')
47	      }
48	      state.pos = matchEnd
49	      return true
50	    }
51	
52	    // Some different length found, put it in cache as upper limit of where closer can be found
53	    state.backticks[closerLength] = matchStart
54	  }
55	
56	  // Scanned through the end, didn't find anything
57	  state.backticksScanned = true
58	
59	  if (!silent) state.pending += marker
60	  state.pos += openerLength
61	  return true
62	}

content.text:
The bug is fixed: an unclosed `[` or `![` no longer turns a later code span into literal text. All three inputs from the report now render as the CommonMark reference does, in the default, commonmark and zero presets.

**Cause:** the link/image rule first scans ahead for the closing `]`, skipping over inline tokens without emitting them. During that lookahead the backticks rule hits the final unmatched `` ` ``, scans to the end of the line and marks its cache of backtick-run positions as complete. That cache only held runs seen after the unmatched one, and never the runs that had been consumed as matched closers. When no `]` was found and the parser rewound to parse the text for real, the opening `` ` `` of the valid span looked up the cache, found no possible closer and was emitted as literal text.

**Fix:** in `src/rules_inline/backticks.ts`, the first time a scan reaches the end without a match, the rule now also records the backtick runs that precede the current position before marking the cache complete. The cache then stays correct when the parser is rewound.

**Verification:**
